# Nib Sorrelgate

The best digger of the Tooth-and-Tool, the Shrewish who build in clay and stone instead of trusting the roots. She built [[Brackenmouth]], every stone of it, and she wants it to be the pattern for every warren on Shervinaw. A leather apron, mortar to the elbows, a pencil behind each ear. Her mark, a circle with a line through it, is cut into everything she builds.

Last spring her deepest shaft broke into a hollow and struck a mother root nobody had mapped. It was already grey. She plugged it with clay and told no one. Play her short with everyone and hardest on herself. She gives orders, measures everything with her eyes, and does not make excuses once she starts telling the truth.
